This is the quest that leads [[character]]s from [[Cantha]] to [[Elona]]. It introduces [[Nightfall]] by allowing you to defend [[Kaineng City]] from an attack by [[Torment creature]]s.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Factions
| nationality = non-Elonian
| transfer = Nightfall
| unstarted = [[Sunspears in Kryta]] 
| locked = [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]
}}

===Objectives===
*Speak with [[Kormir]] at [[Bejunkan Pier]]. 
*Defend [[Kaineng Center (Sunspears in Cantha)|Kaineng Center]] from the evil that threatens to destroy it.
*Speak with Kormir at Bejunkan Pier to arrange to travel to [[Elona]].
*See [[Seamarshal Bendro]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*1,000 [[Experience]]
*''Travel to [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] unlocked.''

==Walkthrough==
This quest is an easier way to gain access to [[Nightfall]] than [[Sunspears in Kryta]], the equivalent quest from [[Prophecies]]: the [[party]] size is eight (instead of six); [[henchmen]] are level 20 (instead of 10); your other allies will be more durable; and it can be easier to take advantage of the geography to bunch up opponents or avoid them.

After setting up your party, enter [[Bejunkan Pier]] and speak to [[Kormir]] who will transport you to a [[Kaineng Center (Sunspears in Cantha)|mission-instance of Kaineng Center]]. You will be confronted by [[Torment Claw]]s and various other Chaos creatures ([[Grasp of Insanity|Grasps of Insanity]], [[Scythe of Chaos|Scythes of Chaos]], and [[Wrathful Storm]]s). Your goal is to destroy the four [[Chaos Rift]]s (large purple bubbles) without succumbing to the [[foe]]s. 

Each time you stand near one of the rifts, a red progress bar will appear; it takes about 10 seconds to take down the rift and once removed, it cannot reappear. After you have banished the fourth rift, a countdown timer will appear (giving you some time to pick up any [[drop]]s), after which you will be returned to the pier. Speak to Kormir again to take you to [[Elona]]. After a short [[cinematic]], you will transported to the [[Sun Docks]]. Speak to Seamarshall Bendro to get credit for the quest.

There is no time limit for the quest so proceed slowly and avoid [[aggro]]ing too many foes at once: [[mob]]s are close together and will easily cause a [[wipe]] if you move too quickly. [[Pull]] foes away from the [[Torment Claw]]s so you can confront those individually; if you do get swarmed, focus on the claws first or at least interrupt their [[Torment Slash]]. A cautious team of one player and seven henchmen can easily succeed while even a well-balanced party of eight players can fail if they over-aggro.

===Skill recommendations===
*Skills that mitigate damage to other allies are helpful, e.g. [[Shelter]].
*[[Interrupt]]s to prevent the [[Torment Claw]]s from using their skills.
*Area-wide or [[party healing]].

In [[Bejunkan Pier]].

===Reward dialogue===
;Seamarshal Bendro
:''Kormir told me to expect you, <Character Name>. We Sunspears are indeed lucky to have such great heroes volunteer to join our battle against the evil that threatens Elona. There is much that must be done to prepare you for the battle that awaits us. When you're ready, I will direct you on your way.''

==Notes==
*This quest unlocks [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] (once you have walked through the portal from [[Sun Docks]]).
*Do not leave the party immediately after the [[Chaos Rift]]s are destroyed; everyone must speak with [[Kormir]] a second time in [[Bejunkan Pier]]. If anyone is missing, you will not be able to travel to the [[Sun Docks]] in Elona.
*You will get credit for completing the quest as long as the countdown timer begins and you wait it out, even if you are defeated.
*Kormir will refer to any character as if they were a Canthan native and has no alternate dialogue.
*See [[Campaign travel]] and [[Ferry]] for additional information.
